'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]], [[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Hamas]] releases six living hostages, including pre-war hostages [[Avera Mengistu]] and [[Hisham al-Sayed]], both captive for more than nine years. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/these-are-the-six-living-hostages-set-to-be-released-saturday/ (''Times of Israel'')]
***[[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] orders the delay of the release of 620 [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[Palestinian prisoners in Israel|prisoners]] indefinitely, citing the "humiliating" procedure of the hostages' release. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-ceasefire-hostages-02-22-2025-364c7abeb679e910cb5acba234469574 (AP)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/live-blog/israel-hamas-ceasefire-live-updates-rcna193120 (NBC News)]
*[[Islamic terrorism in Europe]]
**[[2025 Mulhouse stabbing attack]]
*** A 69-year-old [[Portugal|Portuguese]] [[Lino Sousa Loureiro]] is killed and seven other people are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] attack by a 37-year-old Algerian man at a market in [[Mulhouse]], [[France]]. The stabbing is being treated as a suspected [[Islamic terrorism|Islamic terrorist]] attack. [https://apnews.com/article/france-stabbing-islamic-extremism-mulhouse-f360a94b520b199cdd7f389e6ff5e01c (AP)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/02/22/europe/mulhouse-attack-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[2025 Bukavu offensive]]
***Hundreds of [[Congolese National Police|Congolese police officers]] join the [[March 23 Movement|M23 movement]] in [[Bukavu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], as the rebel group consolidates its control of the city. Around 1,800 police officers have surrendered their weapons to the new authorities, according to the [[Congo River Alliance]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/hundreds-congolese-police-join-rebels-occupied-city-2025-02-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**[[Operation Prosperity Guardian]]
***[[Houthis|Houthi forces]] launch [[surface-to-air missile]]s at a [[United States Air Force|U.S.]] fighter jet and [[General Atomics MQ-9 Reaper|MQ-9 Reaper]] drone over the [[Red Sea]] for the first time with both missiles missing their target. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/yemens-houthis-launched-missile-us-fighter-jet-missed-2025-02-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**The [[Tuareg people|Tuareg]] [[National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad|independence movement]] accuses [[Malian Armed Forces|Malian soldiers]] and [[Wagner Group]] mercenaries of killing 24 civilians, which constitutes a [[war crime]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/2/22/malis-army-says-investigating-soldiers-accused-of-killing-24-civilians (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[75th Berlin International Film Festival]]
**[[Cinema of Norway|Norwegian]] [[drama (film and television)|drama film]] ''[[Dreams (Sex Love)]]'' wins the [[Golden Bear]] award at the 2025 [[Berlin International Film Festival]], while [[Tilda Swinton]] is awarded the [[Honorary Golden Bear]] for her range and [[Tilda Swinton filmography|legacy]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/coming-of-age-film-from-norway-wins-berlinales-golden-bear/a-71716079 (DW)] [https://www.berlinale.de/en/festival/awards-and-juries/honorary-golden-bear.html (Berlinale)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Real Plaza Trujillo roof collapse]]
**The death toll following the [[Structural integrity and failure|structural collapse]] of a metal roof of the [[Real Plaza Trujillo]] in [[Trujillo, Peru|Trujillo]], [[Peru]], rises to eight. The [[Department of La Libertad|La Libertad]] government announces a period of mourning from February 22–23. [https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/2025/02/21/colapsa-techo-de-real-plaza-en-trujillo-en-vivo-reporte-de-heridos-y-ultimas-noticias-segun-coer-1782711 (''La Republica'')]
* A bus crashed into a petrol tanker in [[Niger State]], killing 14 and injuring six. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2591303/world (ARAB NEWS)]
*A bus carrying passengers to a wedding ceremony overturns in Ranhghati, [[Rajasthan]], [[India]], killing two people and injuring 30 others. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/jaipur/two-dead-30-injured-as-bus-overturns/articleshow/118487309.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*[[Telangana tunnel collapse]]
**A tunnel collapse in the under-construction [[Srisailam Left Bank Canal]] project in [[Telangana]], [[India]], trapped eight workers, with only two bodies recovered. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czednek3r2jo (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Cook Islands relations]]
**The [[Cook Islands]] signs a five-year [[memorandum of understanding]] to collaborate with [[China]] in [[seabed mining]], which includes [[technology transfer]], [[logistics]] support, and [[deep-sea community|deep-sea]] [[marine ecosystem|ecosystem]] research. [https://www.dw.com/en/cook-islands-announces-deep-sea-minerals-deal-with-china/a-71711275 (DW)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/feb/22/cook-islands-china-partnership-response (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[UPMC Memorial Hospital shooting]]
**Two people, including a police officer, are killed and seven other people are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at the UPMC Memorial Hospital in [[West Manchester Township, Pennsylvania|West Manchester Township]], [[York County, Pennsylvania|York County]], [[Pennsylvania]], United States. [https://www.ydr.com/story/news/crime/2025/02/22/shooter-targeted-the-icu-at-upmc-memorial-killing-a-police-officer/79682914007/ (''York Daily Record'')] [https://www.fox43.com/article/news/local/york-county/police-incident-upmc-york-public-to-avoid-the-area/521-0c7355f3-6262-4ef5-8b76-9353775cabf9 (Fox News)]
*One person is killed and another is injured in a shooting at the [[Kirtland Air Force Base]] in [[Albuquerque]], [[New Mexico]], United States. The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] is investigating the shooting but it is believed the incident was not an act of [[terrorism]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/shooting-air-force-base-new-mexico-kills-airman-119079724 (ABC News)]
*[[Mohamed Amra]], a [[France|French]] criminal and suspected [[drug lord]] known as "The Fly", is recaptured in [[Romania]], nine months after escaping during an ambush that killed two French prison officers. [https://news.sky.com/story/mohamed-amra-the-fly-recaptured-in-romania-nine-months-after-escape-that-killed-two-french-prison-officers-13314864 (Sky News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Vatican City]] issues a statement informing of the worsening health of [[Pope Francis]] after more than a week in hospital due to [[respiratory disease|respiratory problems]]. Vatican officials say Pope Francis is now in [[critical condition]] and that the prognosis "remains guarded". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/pope-francis-will-not-lead-sunday-prayers-second-week-running-vatican-says-2025-02-22/ (Reuters)]
